analysis: Integration of a media-ingest widening PR. Production Swift change is only provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/Inference/Vision/MediaIngest.swift (head ~769-801): the inline-video header check becomes a lowercased Set lookup (admittedVideoDataURIHeaders), adding data:video/x-m4v;base64 and data:video/mov;base64. The earlier hasPrefix("data:") guard, the dataFromDataURI decoded-byte cap, MemoryBackedVideoAsset (in-memory, container sniffed from bytes, forbidAll references, no temp file) and the duration, frame-pixel, count and aggregate caps are unchanged in the supplied replay. So T-050 and TB-007 are not weakened, and the new labels only widen label strings to the same parser already reachable through video/quicktime. Error text is static. Exact-match header means parameters such as charset are rejected (fail closed). Docs (docs/architecture/inference.md, docs/provider/cli-reference.md, docs/threat-model.yaml 1969-1970, changelog) are consistent with the code. Tests (GLM5NextMediaRoutingTests, MediaIngestTests vlmDecodeVideoLabelAliases) cover alias acceptance, non-MP4 bytes rejection and non-base64 rejection. No T-041 change: media remains excluded from prefix lookup and capture, per the docs. Unverified contracts: (1) the libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule bump 7bed821 to 6aef0a5 is not visible, and it carries the GLM5NextProcessor variable-frame-rate indexing at i/nominalFrameRate (including handling of zero or NaN nominalFrameRate), MemoryBackedVideoAsset sniffing, and whether the 512 MiB decoded-frame cap, the 28,532 visual-token cap and the frame-count and duration bounds still hold for VFR tracks. (2) Native AVFoundation parsing of high-frame-count or VFR clips. Because the submodule diff is not supplied and the VFR decode path is a security-relevant bound, I set needs_deeper_review=true. No supported finding is made from the evidence.
